blocks.text: SANTA CRUZ DE SUCCHABAMBA, Peru — Pope Leo XIV warned Saturday that the heartland of the ancient Inca Empire was “suffering” as the remote, poverty-stricken communities where he served as a missionary in Peru shrink dramatically. The head of the world’s 1.4 billion Catholics flew by helicopter to the isolated town of Santa Cruz de Succhabamba in the Andes Mountains — an area he visited on horseback when he lived in Peru as Robert Francis Prevost. Despite undergoing cancer surgery just one month ago, the 71-year-old pope was determined to visit the town, which sits among green peaks at an altitude […]...
